payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in the context of social media, including specific categories and their distinctions.

claims.text: The types of offensive content explored include hate speech, cyberbullying, cyber-aggression, toxic comments, and abusive language.
Offensive content is categorized into targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
The hierarchical annotation model distinguishes between offensive and non-offensive language, as well as the type and target of the offensive language.
